description: LUNOVA CLOUDER unites three engineering minds from Computer Science, Electrical Engineering and Information Engineering Technology with one mission: keeping astronauts healthy far from Earth. We are building an AI-powered health monitoring system that tracks vital signs in real time, predicts risks before they become emergencies and guides crews with clear alerts. We bring AI/ML, full-stack development and sensor expertise. Seeking a UI/UX designer and storyteller to join our crew.
summary: VITALIS is an offline first health app that helps astronauts check their own health, spot risky trends early and know exactly what to do, even when Earth is 20 minutes away. On a Mars mission a question to a flight surgeon can take 45 minutes to answer, so crews must act on their own. VITALIS turns daily readings, wearable and suit sensors into clear steps: status → why → what to do → when to get help, in plain words a non-doctor understands. A transparent rule engine compares each reading with safe limits and with the astronaut's own 14 day baseline, catching "normal on paper, abnormal for you" changes. It works fully offline as an installable app, raises sound and vibration alarms, and syncs to a Mission Control console whenever a link exists. The demo mission uses real NASA Curiosity rover radiation measurements from its cruise to Mars, and every feature is tagged with NASA's five hazards of human spaceflight. The same approach can help remote clinics, polar stations and ships on Earth.
details:
WHAT IT DOES

VITALIS turns raw health readings into status → explanation → action → escalation for astronauts on deep-space missions, where communication delay means they cannot wait for a flight surgeon.

• Daily check-in (<3 min): 17 measurements + 12 symptoms, glove-friendly controls, "how to measure in space" help. Data can also come from Bluetooth devices/watches, a suit or wearable over USB/Wi-Fi, the camera (experimental heart rate) or a photo of a health report (read on the device).

• Transparent triage engine: absolute limits with sources, personal 14-day baselines, and 11 combination rules (eye/head pressure (SANS), solar storm, mood and isolation, bone loss, sleep debt, infection, kidney stones…). Every alert says why, what to do and when to escalate – timed to the real Earth delay ("doctors on Earth can answer in ~24 min at the earliest, start these steps now").

• Interactive body map with organs, Health Journey replay, trends with personal baseline bands, reaction-time test, mood and "feelings & home" support, countermeasure guides, adaptive schedule, alarms with sound/vibration, calm-mode emergency checklist.

• Mission Control: a realtime Ground Console for the ground team and crew medical officer (alerts, acknowledgements, messages, health reports with PDF).

• Fully offline: installable app; everything is saved on the device and uploaded automatically when a link exists (store-and-forward, like NASA's Delay-Tolerant Networking). Data can move between your own devices without any network.

NASA DATA

The demo mission's radiation is real: 15,358 measurements from the Radiation Assessment Detector on NASA's Curiosity rover during its cruise to Mars (NASA PDS, MSL-M-RAD-3-RDR-V1.0). Day 42 is the real solar storm of 8 March 2012. All five challenge resources (NASA HRP hazards, risks, research; CSA radiation monitoring; CSA science) are used and linked in the app.

BENEFITS AND IMPACT

Safer autonomous medical decisions far from Earth; and on Earth, for remote clinics, polar stations, ships and disaster zones with no doctor and poor connectivity.

TOOLS

TypeScript, React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Zustand, Dexie (IndexedDB), Recharts, Framer Motion, jsPDF, Tesseract.js, Supabase (Postgres with Row Level Security, Realtime), Web Bluetooth/Serial, a hand-written service worker. 114 unit tests and 21 database security tests. Hosted on Vercel/Render.

WHAT WE CONSIDERED

Decision support, not diagnosis; plain language; accessibility (never colour-only, large targets); privacy (journal visible only to its owner); honesty (real vs made-up data clearly labelled in DATA_SOURCES.md).

Live demo (no sign-up): https://vitalis-eta-lac.vercel.app/?demo=1&tour=1
